base_commit_note: origin/main was fetched at e6059f4de (19 commits ahead of the previous merge base 16349648c) and MERGED into this branch, never rebased, before any artifact in this commit was written. The merge was clean and produced merge commit 4e737c70e. It changed none of the three artifacts this archive stages, none of the live approved records of EXP-ECDLP-6ac801 (specification.yaml, specification.v2.yaml, amendments/v1_to_v2.yaml), none of the snapshot-archived v3 paths, and no entry of this batch's dispatch queue or of ledger/goals/GOAL-ECDLP-bbc21f/goal.yaml -- each verified with `git diff 5b3885cbd HEAD -- <path>`. tools/validate_ledger.py was run before and after the merge and reported the SAME 29 pre-existing errors, byte-identical (`diff` of the two error lists is empty), so the merge introduced no validation error.

what_the_merge_brought_in_that_bears_on_.BATCH-8f3e86_is_now_CLOSED: origin/main at e6059f4de carries ledger/goals/GOAL-ECDLP-bbc21f/checkpoints/BATCH-8f3e86.yaml, coordination/goals/GOAL-ECDLP-bbc21f/lanes/BATCH-8f3e86.closed.json, EV-ECDLP-6a4ebc and DEC-20260907-6d9427 (merged as PR #829, lane-close commit b7392dd1e). `python3 tools/goal_lanes.py lanes GOAL-ECDLP-bbc21f` now reports BATCH-8f3e86 CLOSED and BATCH-48ef8b as the only OPEN lane on this goal. This is a MATERIAL CHANGE OF FACT against this lane's own opening records, which describe BATCH-8f3e86 as an open concurrent lane, and against the dispatching instruction for this task. It is recorded here as a fact read from the tool and from the merged records; it is not written onto any BATCH-8f3e86 record and no entry of that lane is edited by this archive.
what_the_merge_brought_in_that_bears_on_.why_it_matters_downstream: DEC-20260907-adbe7e's RANK 5 (finding CF-3) names 'the lane that owns it (BATCH-8f3e86)' as the raiser of the superseding record against the approved specification.v2.yaml of EXP-ECDLP-6ac801. That lane has closed, so that remedy is now UNOWNED. This receipt does not reassign it -- reassignment is a ranking act and belongs to the lane-close task TASK-20260907-1aa16f and its decision DEC-20260907-de6b71, not to an archival receipt.
what_the_merge_brought_in_that_bears_on_.no_finding_of_the_gate_is_affected: The gate reviewed the bytes at 176b7d93e with head 3c7bd2293, and every path it cites is byte-unchanged by the merge. Nothing in DEC-20260907-adbe7e is re-scored, softened or extended by this archive.

A refusal is a research record, not the absence of one. specification.v3.yaml remains UNAPPROVED and NOT execution-authorized.

Changes no task state in the dispatch queue (done in the follow-up backfill commit).

Adds no measurement, no run record, no evidence record and no attestation. Every recomputation cited in DEC-20260907-adbe7e -- W and cap at eight cells, the accounting identity at twenty committed cells, the allowlist hashes, the byte-identity comparisons, the fifteen control labels -- was performed by the TASK-20260907-9c0626 gate session. THIS ARCHIVE PERFORMED NONE OF IT and cites it as the gate's.

Edits no approved, frozen or snapshot-archived byte. In particular it does not repair the gate's finding CF-3 in the approved specification.v2.yaml; that remedy is a superseding record raised elsewhere and is named, not performed.
asserts_nothing_about: No research finding, no G3 feasibility result at any a, at either scale; no per-cell verdict, no margin, no pass-count, no prior and no numeric value of the quantity under test. This receipt records that a document gate's refusal and its two reports are durable committed state.
